name: Little Test
summary: Test App from a brain imaging course that resamples an ACPC-aligned T1-weighted image to a requested voxel resolution with DIPY reslice.
description: Course exercise forked from the brainlife Python App template. It reslices the T1w image to the outres voxel size with dipy.align.reslice and writes t1.nii.gz. Not intended for production use.

inputs.description: This t1w data will be resampled with the input "outres" resolution.

parameters.description: Desired out resolution of the t1w data. 3 integers/flow point numbers in millimeters.
